title: Archimedean Modular Symbols for Rankin-Selberg Convolutions of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})\times\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ and $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})\times\mathrm{GL}_{n+1}(\mathbb{C})$
summary: We explicit calculate the archimedean modular symbol for Rankin-Selberg convolutions of $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})\times\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})$ and $\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{C})\times\mathrm{GL}_{n+1}(\mathbb{C})$, for all generic cohomological representations.
